name: Birdpipes
descriptionHtml: Pan pipes or satyr pipes, also known as the shalm, these are sacred to Lliira|Faerûnian|scag and popular with wood elf and wild elf bards.

name: Glaur
descriptionHtml: Short, curved horns like a cornucopia. Played with valves, glaur sound like trumpets, while those without valves, known as gloon, have a more mournful sound.

name: Hand Drum
descriptionHtml: A double-headed skin drum fitted with handles along its side.

name: Longhorn
descriptionHtml: A Faerûnian flute of sophisticated make, found only in areas with skilled artisans, as in great cities or elven enclaves.

name: Shawm
descriptionHtml: A double-reed instrument similar to an oboe or a bassoon, popular with gnomes, who have developed some bellows-powered versions.

name: Songhorn
descriptionHtml: A recorder, a simple type of flute, usually carved from wood.

name: Spiked Armor
descriptionHtml: Spiked armor is a rare type of medium armor made by dwarves. It consists of a leather coat and leggings covered with spikes that are usually made of metal.

name: Tantan
descriptionHtml: A tambourine, a popular instrument with halflings and humans south of the Dalelands.

name: Thelarr
descriptionHtml: Also known as a whistlecane, a simple and easy-to-make wind instrument cut from a reed. They are so simple, in fact, that skilled bards frequently make and give them away to children—to the parents' delight or regret.

name: Tocken
descriptionHtml: A hanging set of carved oval bells, usually played with a pair of light wooden hammers (or open handed). They are most common in underground cultures, where the resonant tones can carry.

name: Wargong
descriptionHtml: A metal gong, traditionally made from a shield, particularly the shield of an enemy. Both goblins and dwarves make and play wargongs, their sound echoing through tunnels in the Underdark.

name: Yarting
descriptionHtml: A southern instrument from Amn and Calimshan that is a Faerûnian analog to the guitar. Numerous variations have spread across the continent.

name: Zulkoon
descriptionHtml: A complex pump organ that originated with the zulkirs of Thay, who use it in the casting of their spells. It is considered to have a dramatic, but sinister, sound.
